description: §66.3 rule 5: unannotated non-literal own values drawn from every member of the inferable set (a typed @ref, arithmetic, `/`, a comparison, a ternary, `.length`, `+` over strings, a sequence literal, a call with a declared return, a call with an inferred-and-proven return) compile with no own-value type code, and the derived values track their dependency (base 3 → 4).
rationale: §66.3 rule 5: "An own value written without `:T` whose initializer is not a literal takes its type from its INITIALIZER … The initializer SHALL be a member of the inferable set" — literals; a typed `@ref`; arithmetic, comparison, ternary and `.length` over members; a call of a function whose return type is DECLARED or INFERRED-AND-PROVEN. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "go on the package" (dd own-value-type-annotation-o35d-dpa-065 §8 rulings 2–3).
